paco-rabanne-1-million.name: 1 Million

campaigns.title: Million Nation (shared 1 Million / Lady Million film)
campaigns.setting: Black-and-white party scene, finger snaps, gold and wealth symbols

paco-rabanne-1-million.remarks: Director of the 2019 film conflicts: BuzzWebzine names Oliver Hadlee Pearch, too-young.com names Paul Gore (Standard/Iconoclast); left blank. The finger snap is the recurring signature of the 1 Million / Lady Million films. No reliable credits found for the 2008 launch film or a 2021-2026 1 Million film. Million Gold For Her (2024, Gigi Hadid, 'Pure/Honey' by Beyonce) is a separate women's line, recorded under Lady Million as related context.

paco-rabanne-invictus.name: Invictus

campaigns.setting: Stadium; athletes worshipped as modern gods, mythology references

music.title: We Are the Champions
music.note: La Reclame calls it a reinterpretation of the Queen song

paco-rabanne-invictus.remarks: Current campaign (2026) director not found. Kanye West 'POWER' is the music most associated with Invictus in France.

paco-rabanne-lady-million.name: Lady Million

music.title: Do It Again
music.note: 2011 airing credited as a cover by Alexandre Geindre; 2012 airing credited to the original

paco-rabanne-lady-million.remarks: 2024 entry is Million Gold For Her, the successor women's line, not Lady Million itself; include as context. Lady Million films share the finger-snap signature with 1 Million.

paco-rabanne-phantom.name: Phantom

campaigns.setting: Retro-futuristic 'Paco Galaxy', Palm Springs-like setting; robot-shaped bottle

paco-rabanne-phantom.remarks: 2021 production company Partizan, VFX The Mill Paris (The Mill). 2023 production company Division per The Mill.

paco-rabanne-fame.name: Fame

campaigns.setting: Paris, 7th arrondissement at night, Seine and Pegasus statue

paco-rabanne-fame.remarks: Thin: director not confirmed (one magazine names Solal Micenmacher for visuals, not recorded). Only one film campaign found; later Fame flanker films reuse Elle Fanning.

jean-paul-gaultier-le-male.name: Le Male

campaigns.title: Mondino era sailor films (Le Male / Classique)

music.title: Casta Diva (Norma)
music.note: aria sung by Angela Gheorghiu per BuzzWebzine; signature music of the line

jean-paul-gaultier-le-male.remarks: Year of first Mondino film is not firmly dated by sources (the fragrance launched 1995; Mondino 'helmed' the early joint Le Male/Classique films). On the Docks dated 2013 by trade press, 2016 by Adland. 'Casta Diva' is constant across campaigns.

jean-paul-gaultier-scandal.name: Scandal

music.title: It's Like That
music.note: Jason Nevins remix of the 1983/84 Run-DMC track

jean-paul-gaultier-scandal.remarks: 2021 entry is the men's flanker Scandal pour Homme; 2025 is Scandal Intense.

jean-paul-gaultier-la-belle.name: La Belle

campaigns.setting: Garden of Eden theme with La Belle and Le Beau

jean-paul-gaultier-la-belle.remarks: THIN: no reliable source found for the face, director or music of the La Belle films. Only the Eden / La Belle and Le Beau concept is documented. Needs manual check on the official JPG YouTube channel.

jean-paul-gaultier-classique.name: Classique

campaigns.title: Mondino era joint films (Classique / Le Male)

jean-paul-gaultier-classique.remarks: Classique shares its films with Le Male (sailor + corseted woman). 1993 launch film not documented; 1995 is the start of the joint Mondino films (approximate).

thierry-mugler-alien.name: Alien
thierry-mugler-alien.remarks: Sigismondi film year from a 2014 OSMOZ article (approximate). Production for Sigismondi film: Believe Media.

thierry-mugler-angel.name: Angel

campaigns.title: Angel Elixir
campaigns.setting: Top of a New York skyscraper

thierry-mugler-angel.remarks: Faces timeline also includes Bianca Balti (2006) and Eva Mendes (2011). Music/director for 1990s-2010s films not found. 2022 'We Are All Angel' 30th anniversary film used an original track by Asma Maroof (BuzzWebzine, single source).

dolce-gabbana-light-blue.name: Light Blue
dolce-gabbana-light-blue.remarks: Year of first Testino film approximate (Testino shot the original Capri campaign from 2006/2007; launch was 2001). Cinematographer John Mathieson on Testino films. Music for Light Blue films not found in clean sources.

dolce-gabbana-the-one.name: The One

music.title: Il cielo in una stanza
music.note: Mental Floss instead cites 'She Said Yeah' (Rolling Stones)

music.title: Quando quando quando (Clarke) / Tu vuò fa' l'americano (Harington)
music.note: Clarke sings 'Quando'; Harington film uses the Neapolitan song with swing/jazz arrangement

music.title: La bambola
music.note: cover of Patty Pravo, sung in Italian, produced with Stuart Price

dolce-gabbana-the-one.remarks: 2017 Clarke film is for The Only One/The One women; Harington film for The One for Men. Music of 2013 film conflicts between sources.

hugo-boss-boss-bottled.name: Boss Bottled
hugo-boss-boss-bottled.remarks: Boss Bottled Parfum 'La nouvelle intensité' film uses an electro version of 'Let's Go Go Go' by Tigerblood Jewel (BuzzWebzine, single source, year not stated). Hemsworth also fronted Bottled Absolu (2024).

hugo-boss-boss-alive.name: Boss Alive

campaigns.setting: Apartment, terrace, street, car; ends with the four women in the street at night

hugo-boss-boss-alive.remarks: Aired 2020 and again 2021 in France. No later Boss Alive film found. 'musique pub parfum alive' = 'What's Up' by 4 Non Blondes.

montblanc-explorer.name: Explorer

music.title: original composition
music.note: made for the campaign, not commercially released

music.title: Music for Meditation and Sleep, Vol. 3
music.note: ambient, no dialogue in the film

montblanc-explorer.remarks: THIN: no director or agency found for any Explorer film; 2019 launch film music not found.

montblanc-legend.name: Legend
montblanc-legend.remarks: 2011 launch film not documented. Zidane 2022 director/music not found.

carolina-herrera-good-girl.name: Good Girl

campaigns.title: It's so good to be bad

music.title: Baby Did a Bad Bad Thing

carolina-herrera-good-girl.remarks: 'Baby Did a Bad Bad Thing' is reused across many Good Girl spots (2019-2021). Very Good Girl Glam (2022) used 'I'm Every Woman' by Chaka Khan (BuzzWebzine). Directors not found.

carolina-herrera-bad-boy.name: Bad Boy

music.title: Baby Did a Bad Bad Thing
Baby Did a Bad Bad Thing

carolina-herrera-bad-boy.remarks: Directors of the main Bad Boy films not found.

givenchy-linterdit.name: L'Interdit

music.title: Deceive
music.note: film opens with Max Richter 'Berlin by Overnight'

campaigns.setting: Paris party, then underground party in a Paris metro station (Porte des Lilas)

givenchy-linterdit.remarks: Original L'Interdit (1957) was created for Audrey Hepburn; the 2018 relaunch is the reference campaign. Cinematographer Philippe Le Sourd on 2024 film (Elle Belgium, single source).

prada-paradoxe.name: Paradoxe
prada-paradoxe.remarks: Watson's directorial debut. Creative directors Miuccia Prada and Raf Simons. No later Paradoxe film credits found.

prada-luna-rossa-carbon.name: Luna Rossa Carbon
prada-luna-rossa-carbon.remarks: THIN: no source found for a Luna Rossa Carbon-specific film (2017 launch). Entries are for the Luna Rossa line (2012) and Luna Rossa Ocean (2021) as context only.

chloe-chloe-eau-de-parfum.name: Chloé Eau de Parfum
chloe-chloe-eau-de-parfum.remarks: Love Story (2014, Mélanie Laurent, 'Mi Amor' by Vanessa Paradis) is a separate Chloé fragrance, not recorded.

burberry-her.name: Burberry Her

music.title: Maybe It's Because I'm a Londoner
music.note: cover of the Hubert Gregg song, sung by Delevingne

burberry-her.remarks: 2026 director not found. Creative director at launch: Riccardo Tisci.

burberry-hero.name: Burberry Hero

campaigns.setting: Beach at sunrise; horse, sea; centaur image

burberry-hero.remarks: Year of the EDP follow-up approximate ('almost a year after').

versace-eros.name: Eros

campaigns.setting: Greek temple, storm, bow and arrow

versace-eros.remarks: 2024 music not found. Creative direction Donatella Versace for both.

kenzo-flower-by-kenzo.name: Flower by Kenzo

music.title: What a Way to Win a War

kenzo-flower-by-kenzo.remarks: Patrick Guedj (Kenzo Parfums creative director) directed most films of the saga per Paris Match. Year for Lavault film: 2022 per BuzzWebzine, described as 2023 campaign elsewhere.

gucci-bloom.name: Gucci Bloom
gucci-bloom.remarks: 2020 film includes stop-motion flower sequence by the Brothers Quay. Concept by Alessandro Michele.

narciso-rodriguez-narciso-rodriguez-for-.name: For Her

campaigns.title: Launch
campaigns.photographer: Inez van Lamsweerde and Vinoodh Matadin

campaigns.title: For Her Eau de Parfum Intense

narciso-rodriguez-narciso-rodriguez-for-.remarks: THIN: no director or music found for the main For Her films. Carmen Kass was the face for about 17 years.

viktor-rolf-flowerbomb.name: Flowerbomb

campaigns.director: Inez van Lamsweerde and Vinoodh Matadin
campaigns.photographer: Inez van Lamsweerde and Vinoodh Matadin

viktor-rolf-flowerbomb.remarks: Earlier face Andreea Diaconu (10th anniversary, Inez & Vinoodh). Emily Ratajkowski film directed by Torso Solutions (date not stated). Current campaign not found.
